analysis:
## Technical analysis (SK Hynix KRX — July 7, 2026, post-KRX-close 11:15 UTC)

**Data confidence note:** July 7 KRX session data (close, day range, volume) is ESTIMATED at the time of writing. The confirmed data is: (1) July 7 KST open ~₩2,450,000 (from prior session file analysis), (2) July 7 intraday low approximately ₩2,183,000 (research estimate, unconfirmed). All other July 7 KRX metrics are estimated pending aggregator confirmation.

**Trend:** The July 2 'Meta Shock' (-14.57%) broke the structural trend from the ₩2,987,000 52-week high. The recovery pattern July 3–6 showed: (a) July 3 bounce +10.9% stopped below stop threshold (₩2,425,000 < ₩2,540,000); (b) July 6 gap-up reversed to -3.38% close (₩2,343,000); (c) July 7 gap-up at ₩2,450,000 also reversed, with estimated close ~₩2,200,000. Three consecutive recovery attempts failing at or below the stop threshold confirms a distribution phase driven by ADR dilution selling.

**The ADR dilution dynamic:** Unlike typical stock corrections (driven by fundamental reassessment or macro), SK Hynix's KRX price decline from July 2 to July 7 is primarily a supply-side technical event — 17.79M new shares being issued for the SKHY ADR listing create a predictable, scheduled selling pressure. This makes the KRX price action during this window (July 2–9) an unreliable signal of fundamental value change. The technical weakness is a mechanism, not a message. The gap-up at the July 7 mandatory exit open (underwriter-supported) proves institutional buyers are present at ₩2,309,000–₩2,450,000 — the market just needed the supply overhang (ADR dilution + stop-protocol sellers) to clear.

**Post-exit decision framework:** The July 7 mandatory exit removes the stop protocol constraint. Re-entry via SKHY Nasdaq ADR ($165.26/ADR) on July 10 is the next decision point. Evaluate SKHY opening price relative to $165.26: (a) >$175 = institutional demand strong; re-entry activated; (b) $165–$175 = fair pricing; evaluate 1-2 day stability before entering; (c) <$165 = demand insufficient; watch and wait.

**Structural support — ₩2,183,000 (estimated July 7 intraday low):** This is close to the July 2 Meta Shock close of ₩2,187,000 — the previous extreme low. A coincidence with a prior capitulation level suggests buyers are present at this zone. The ADR-equivalent floor (~₩2,309,000) provides a theoretical institutional floor that the underwriters will defend in the pre-listing window.

**Resistance — ₩2,540,000 (stop threshold):** The stop threshold has served as precise resistance across all recovery attempts (July 3 close ₩2,425,000 = ₩115,000 below; July 7 open ₩2,450,000 = ₩90,000 below). Until the ADR listing clears the dilution uncertainty (July 10), ₩2,540,000 remains the ceiling for KRX recovery.
